definitions.explanation: Multiple musicians playing instruments together. Refers to the act of performing as a group or the resulting performance.

examples.japanese: みんなで{合奏|がっそう}する。
examples.english: We all play together as an ensemble.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{合奏|がっそう}の{練習|れんしゅう}をした。
examples.english: We practiced ensemble playing in music class.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちがリコーダーの{合奏|がっそう}を{披露|ひろう}してくれた。
examples.english: The children performed a recorder ensemble for us.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合奏|がっそう}{曲|きょく}: ensemble piece
- {合奏|がっそう}{練習|れんしゅう}: ensemble practice
- {合奏|がっそう}を{披露|ひろう}する: to perform an ensemble piece

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {独奏|どくそう}: solo (one person playing)
- {合唱|がっしょう}: choir, singing together (vocal, not instrumental)
- {演奏|えんそう}: musical performance (general term, solo or group)
